test_title: PYST 60: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following summits in 2025 will be co-hosted by World Health Organization (WHO) and the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India in New Delhi, aiming to strengthen traditional medicine globally?

options.text: Second WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine 2025
Global Health and Traditional Medicine Summit 2025

solution:
The correct answer is __**Second WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Second WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine** is scheduled to be held in **2025** in **New Delhi**, India, marking a significant milestone in global healthcare collaboration.
 
• This high-level event is co-hosted by the **World Health Organization (WHO)** and the **Ministry of Ayush**, Government of India, reflecting a strong partnership to promote traditional healing systems.
 
• The summit aims to strengthen the **evidence-based integration** of traditional, complementary, and integrative medicine (TCIM) into national health systems and **global health policies**.
 
• It serves as a follow-up to the **First WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine**, which took place in **Gandhinagar, Gujarat**, in **August 2023**.
 
• The **2025 summit** will focus on **innovation**, **digital health**, and the application of **modern science** to validate traditional knowledge for the benefit of human health and the planet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Ayush:** 
 
 
• The **Ministry of Ayush** was established on **9th November 2014** by the Government of India to ensure the development and propagation of **Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy**.
 
• It plays a pivotal role in positioning India as a global leader in **traditional medicine** through research, education, and international partnerships.
 
 
 
• **WHO Global Centre for Traditional Medicine (GCTM):** 
 
 
• Located in **Jamnagar, Gujarat**, the **GCTM** is the first and only global center of its kind established by the **World Health Organization**.
 
• It acts as a **knowledge hub** to catalyze ancient wisdom and modern science for the health of people and the planet, focusing on **evidence, data, and sustainability**.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat Declaration:** 
 
 
• Following the first summit in **2023**, the **Gujarat Declaration** was released, highlighting the global commitment to scaling up the **scientific validation** of traditional medicine.
 
• It emphasizes the role of traditional medicine in achieving **Universal Health Coverage (UHC)** and **Sustainable Development Goal 3 (SDG 3)**.
 
 
 
• **Global Prevalence:** 
 
 
• According to WHO data, approximately **80%** of the world’s population uses **traditional medicine**, and it is a major part of the health economy in many countries.
 
• Nearly **40%** of approved **pharmaceutical products** today are derived from **natural substances**, underlining the importance of biodiversity and traditional knowledge.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **International Classification:** The WHO has integrated traditional medicine modules into the **ICD-11 (International Classification of Diseases)** to enable standardized clinical documentation and **global data collection**.
 
• **Strategic Goals:** The **2025 summit** in **New Delhi** is expected to address the **regulatory frameworks** required for the quality, safety, and efficacy of traditional medicinal products.
 
• **Biodiversity and Sustainability:** A key theme involves the **sustainable sourcing** of medicinal plants and protecting the **intellectual property rights** of indigenous communities who hold traditional health knowledge.
 
• **Technology Integration:** The summit will likely explore how **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and **Genomics** can be used to study the multi-component nature of traditional formulations.
